question.text: STT rate on sale of EQUITY-ORIENTED MUTUAL FUND units (delivery-based, via recognized exchange):

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.3.3, STT on delivery-based sale of equity-oriented MF units = 0.001% on transaction value. **The Trap:** Other rates apply to different transactions. **Cross-Exam Context:** Common STT rate that trips up test-takers. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Include STT reconciliation in monthly fund accounting.
